description: Elections Commission - Declare that M. P. N. Irfan as a Member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of declaring a new council member elected to replace one who ceased to be a member of their political party. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
